title: The calendar Today-button test read the real clock and has failed on main since 2026-10-01

source.ref: found 2026-10-05 by the scan-six full test run (20,428 passed, 1 failed)

detail:
FOUND 2026-10-05 in the scan-six full `pnpm test`. 'keeps Today mounted and disabled' mounts September 2026, presses Next month and expects Today ENABLED, then presses Today and expects September. It never pinned the clock, so from 2026-10-01 Next month lands on the real current month, Today is disabled, and the case fails: on main and on every pull request, unrelated to the diff.

CLOSED 2026-10-05: the case pins Date to 2026-09-15 with vi.useFakeTimers({ toFake: ['Date'] }) and restores it in onTestFinished. The other EventCalendar render tests pass today; any that read Today against a fixed month have the same shape and want the same pin.

verify.cmd: node -e 'const s=require("fs").readFileSync("components/events/event-calendar.a11y.render.test.tsx","utf8");const i=s.indexOf("keeps Today mounted and disabled");if(i<0||!/vi\.setSystemTime\(/.test(s.slice(i,i+800))){console.error("SCAN-653: the Today-button case reads Today as September 2026 without pinning the clock, so it fails whenever the real month is the one after initialMonth1 and turns every PR red.");process.exit(1)}'
verify.note: Reads the case for a pinned clock.
